warnings: Four public HTML pages sampled on 2026-09-13; HTTP 200 observed, fetch timings not retained. robots.txt and sitemap verified on 2026-09-12.
No Search Console, analytics, backlink, search-volume or Core Web Vitals data was connected.
Competitor positioning is based on public first-party pages, not measured search-result rankings.

strategy.summary:
Patriot has the basic HTML foundations in the four sampled pages: HTTPS, titles, canonical declarations, structured data and extractable service content. The homepage passes 95/100 checklist points. This measures presence, not rankings, indexing or performance. The immediate priorities are trust and conversion: reconcile the company timeline and contact email, improve social metadata, and review testimonial-icon accessibility.

Use distinct page roles for solar installation, home energy audits and EmPower+ guidance. Improve existing financing, testimonials and post-installation pages before creating competing URLs. Four active providers overlap with Patriot: SUNation and Long Island Power Solutions in solar, Green Team LI in home efficiency, and Marcor in adjacent roofing/solar service. Differentiate with clear processes, verified local project evidence and helpful service content.

The 90-day plan starts with factual corrections and measurement setup, then fills confirmed content gaps and evaluates recorded search and lead outcomes. Current incentive eligibility and savings claims require verification; no ranking improvement is promised.
strengths: Dedicated service pages for solar benefits and NYSERDA/EmPower+ assessment plus company page provide a foundation for service-intent mapping

HTTPS pages with self-referencing canonicals, no blocking robots meta found, and LocalBusiness/Organization-type schema present in the HTML sample; actual indexability and indexing still need verification.
1,323-word homepage and 51-59 internal links per page suggest crawlable structure for deeper service/location architecture
Long Island/NYC geographic framing throughout matches stated service area
Lead forms, phone numbers, address and testimonials present for conversion and local trust
risks: Conflicting founding narrative (after Hurricane Sandy in 2012 vs Since 2014) undermines trust if left unresolved
Contact email domain inconsistency (body plural vs footer singular) risks lost leads and trust; verify correct mailbox
Generic social title Home and BBB-badge social image weaken click presentation; not a ranking factor alone
12 homepage images missing alt (reported as repeated testimonial icons) need manual decorative vs informative review, not keyword stuffing
Four-page sample cannot prove sitewide coverage; service/location gaps, duplicates, speed, and backlinks were not measured
